question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Locating directions through the location of stars and constellations is a ________ (handy) way at the sea.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Useful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Handy"** describes something that is useful or convenient. ("उपयोगी" or "सहज").

 
 
• **Example:** A swiss army knife is a handy tool to have when camping.
 
 
 
• **"Useful" **suggests something that can be used beneficially or advantageously. ("उपयोगी" or "लाभदायक").
 
 
• **Example:** A map is very useful for someone who is traveling to an unfamiliar place.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Near' **generally refers to a short distance in space or time. "नज़दीक" or "समीप".
 
• **'Simple'** implies something that is easy to understand or do, and does not directly mean useful or handy. ("साधारण" or "सरल").
 
• **'Nice' **often refers to something pleasing or agreeable, and does not imply usefulness. ("अच्छा" or "सुंदर").
